test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2023: Official Paper (Held On: 10 Aug, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
In a certain code language,

Z + B means 'Z is the mother of B',

Z - B means 'Z is the brother of B',

Z @ B means 'Z is the sister of B',

Z # B means 'Z is the father of B'.

If D - E # F - G, then how is D related to G?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/34b738aa9f4d44f180bcd8434ab30fd8c01193aa5f20fb536de68443afb7433c.png] 

The family tree can be drawn using the given information,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/11250b7603498257c27368d77248b50c96cd71ea1dacfd777fa7c865ba27fe9a.png] 

Here, we can see that D is the father's brother of G.

Hence, the correct answer is **"****Father's brother"**.
